findings.title: Sticky navigation obscures the primary Check answer control
findings.problem: The increased question-layout height causes the bottom-sticky .q-nav-wrap to overlap the preceding Check answer button. In the committed post-change adaptive-practice screenshot, the navigation's white background visibly cuts through the button label.
findings.failure_scenario: Open the captured multiple-choice question at the harness's 720×620 viewport. Check answer is partly covered before any scrolling. Selecting an answer does not change this geometry, so the primary grading control remains obscured while Skip and Next remain fully exposed.
findings.fix: Keep Check answer in an unobscured action region, either alongside the sticky navigation or by preventing that navigation from overlapping preceding controls. Recapture the affected image and add a browser regression that checks the enabled button's bounds and hit-testing at this viewport and on short phone screens.

assessment: One major layout regression is visible in the supplied post-change screenshot. No clinical or scoring defect was verified from the supplied material. Tests and build were not executed.
